Name: Position
Description: Group containing parameters for adjusting the 3D position of the object or mesh within the scene.

Name: Drop to Floor
Description: Automatically positions the object so its lowest point rests on the ground plane, preventing it from floating or being embedded below the surface.

Name: Offset X
Description: Shifts the object horizontally along the X axis, allowing precise placement within the 3D space.

Name: Offset Y
Description: Shifts the object horizontally along the Y axis, moving it forward or backward in the 3D scene.

Name: Offset Z
Description: Moves the object vertically along the Z axis, raising or lowering its elevation relative to the ground.

Name: Scale
Description: Group containing parameters for scaling the object or mesh, affecting its size and proportions in 3D space.

Name: Scale
Description: Uniformly scales the object in all directions, making it larger or smaller while maintaining proportions.

Name: Rotation
Description: Group containing parameters for rotating the object around its axes in 3D space.

Name: Pitch
Description: Rotates the object around the X axis, tilting it forward or backward.

Name: Yaw
Description: Rotates the object around the Y axis, turning it left or right.

Name: Roll
Description: Rotates the object around the Z axis, spinning it clockwise or counterclockwise.

Name: Quality
Description: Group containing parameters that affect the rendering quality of the transformed object or mesh.

Name: Antialiasing
Description: Enables or adjusts antialiasing for the 3D transformation, reducing jagged edges and improving visual smoothness.
